name: Databricks Native Experimentation
overview: Run experiments in LaunchDarkly using data in your Databricks warehouse to power your results.
description: Enable LaunchDarkly's experimentation platform to read and analyze data from your Databricks warehouse
author: LaunchDarkly

formVariables.name: Step 1: Connect to Databricks
formVariables.description: Enter your Databricks workspace and SQL warehouse connection details.

formVariables.name: Databricks workspace URL
formVariables.description: The URL of your Databricks workspace (e.g., https://your-workspace.cloud.databricks.com)

formVariables.name: SQL warehouse HTTP path
formVariables.description: The HTTP path to your SQL warehouse (e.g., /sql/1.0/warehouses/abc123)

formVariables.name: Service principal access token
formVariables.description: The access token for your Databricks service principal

formVariables.name: Step 2: Choose LaunchDarkly environment
formVariables.description: Select the LaunchDarkly project and environment that will use this Databricks connection.

formVariables.name: Project and environment
formVariables.description: Select your LaunchDarkly project and environment. You cannot edit this after you save the configuration.

formVariables.name: Step 3: Data storage
formVariables.description: Specify where your event data is stored and where LaunchDarkly should write experiment results.

formVariables.name: Unity Catalog catalog name
formVariables.description: The name of the Unity Catalog catalog containing your data

formVariables.name: Schema name for results
formVariables.description: The schema name where experiment results will be stored

formVariables.name: Step 4: Metrics settings
formVariables.description: Configure where metric events are stored in Databricks.

formVariables.name: Metrics catalog name
formVariables.description: The Databricks catalog where metric events are stored

formVariables.name: Metrics schema name
formVariables.description: The schema within the metrics catalog (leave blank for all schemas)

formVariables.name: Step 5: Run SQL setup
formVariables.description: Run the SQL script below to set up required objects in Databricks.

formVariables.name: SQL setup script
formVariables.description: Copy and run this script in Databricks to create the required objects for the integration.
instructions: In Databricks, open a SQL editor attached to the warehouse you entered above.
Copy the script below and run it.
If you update catalog/schema values, re-run the script.

formVariables.name: Recurring Task Id
formVariables.description: The task id of the scheduled work task for this integration
